description: This file defines the dBug class responsible for dumping and displaying the contents of variables in a visually styled, colored tabular format. It includes methods for handling various data types such as arrays, objects, resources, XML, and primitive types, along with embedded JavaScript and CSS for toggling visibility of nested structures.

classes.name: dBug
classes.description: A class designed to facilitate variable inspection by dumping variable contents in a styled, interactive HTML table with expandable/collapsible nodes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object, sets options, and processes the variable to be dumped.

methods.name: getVariableName
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the variable name from the call stack for display purposes.

methods.name: makeTableHeader
methods.description: Creates the main table header for a data type section.

methods.name: makeTDHeader
methods.description: Creates a table row for a key or label within the dump.

methods.name: closeTDRow
methods.description: Closes a table row.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Generates an error message for unsupported variable types.

methods.name: checkType
methods.description: Determines the type of a variable and calls the appropriate handler.

methods.name: varIsNULL
methods.description: Handles output for null variables.

methods.name: varIsBoolean
methods.description: Handles output for boolean variables.

methods.name: varIsArray
methods.description: Recursively dumps array variables with handling for recursion.

methods.name: varIsObject
methods.description: Recursively dumps object variables, including their properties and methods, with recursion detection.

methods.name: varIsResource
methods.description: Handles dumping of resource variables, including database, GD, and XML resources.

methods.name: varIsDBResource
methods.description: Handles dumping of database resource variables.

methods.name: varIsGDResource
methods.description: Handles dumping of GD image resources.

methods.name: varIsXml
methods.description: Handles dumping of XML variables.

methods.name: varIsXmlResource
methods.description: Handles dumping of XML resource variables, including parsing the XML structure.

methods.name: xmlParse
methods.description: Parses XML data with the PHP XML parser.

methods.name: xmlStartElement
methods.description: Handler for XML start tags, captures element attributes.

methods.name: xmlEndElement
methods.description: Handler for XML end tags, recursively processes nested elements.

methods.name: xmlCharacterData
methods.description: Handler for XML text data between tags.

methods.name: xmlDefaultHandler
methods.description: Handler for miscellaneous XML data, such as comments.

methods.name: initJSandCSS
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript and CSS for interactive collapsible/expandable dump view.
